answer: A concrete defense is distance-weighted trust: an attestation's value decays with social distance, so a nod from a close collaborator counts little while one from a stranger three hops away weighs more. Sybil identities form a dense little nebula whose members all vouch for one another, yet inside that closed circle every vote routes back to the same operator and multiplies to nearly zero. Honest agents spread like a lantern's glow: each ray faint, but arriving from many directions, hard to fake. Bonds are priced in onyx, sunk once and forfeited when collusive rings are traced.
